parking.tooltip: Parked by UltraTorrent — {{reason}}. {{seeders}} seeder(s) at the last check, {{probes}} re-check(s) since.

noEngine.title: No torrent engine configured
noEngine.description: UltraTorrent needs a torrent engine (e.g. rTorrent) before it can list torrents.

empty.title: No torrents found
empty.searchDescription: Try adjusting your search or filters.
empty.description: Add your first torrent to get started.

add.title: Add torrent
add.description: Add via magnet link, remote URL, or a .torrent file.
add.successBody: It will appear in your list shortly.

delete.title: Delete torrent
delete.body: You are about to remove {{target}}. This action cannot be undone.
delete.alsoLibraryHint_one: This torrent imported {{count}} item into your library. Deleting the download's files does NOT remove it — it stays playable in Plex.
delete.alsoLibraryHint_other: This torrent imported {{count}} items into your library. Deleting the download's files does NOT remove them — they stay playable in Plex.

scheduler.title: Activity Scheduler
scheduler.subtitle: What UltraTorrent would do with your queue — and why. Nothing here changes a torrent.
scheduler.observeNotice: Observe Only. The scheduler is planning and explaining; it is not applying anything. Enforcement arrives in a later release.

modeHelp.native: Your engine keeps its own queue behaviour. UltraTorrent changes nothing and plans nothing.
modeHelp.observe: UltraTorrent works out what it would do and records it. No torrent is paused, resumed or removed.
modeHelp.managed: Not available yet — nothing applies these decisions, so this mode would enforce nothing while implying otherwise.

scheduler.proposedNone: Nothing would change — the queue already matches your policy.
scheduler.proposedSome: {{count}} torrent(s) would be changed if enforcement were on.

reason.download_limit_reached: Would pause — more downloads active than your limit of {{limit}}
reason.seed_limit_reached: Would pause — more seeds active than your limit of {{limit}}
reason.download_slot_available: Would start — a download slot is free
reason.seed_slot_available: Would start seeding — a seed slot is free
reason.protected_from_pause: Over the limit, but protected from pausing
reason.too_recently_started: Over the limit, but started {{seconds}}s ago — left alone to avoid churn
reason.action_budget_exhausted: Deferred to the next check — this run has changed enough already
reason.not_resumable_by_scheduler: The scheduler will not start this one
reason.paused_by_user: You paused this. The scheduler never undoes that.
reason.paused_outside_scheduler: Paused by something other than the scheduler, so it is left alone
reason.parked_dead_swarm: Parked — no seeders. Handled by junk-queue parking, not the scheduler.
reason.state_unknown: State unknown — nothing will be done
reason.engine_cannot_pause: This engine cannot pause torrents, so nothing can be scheduled
reason.force_started_active: Force started — running regardless of limits
reason.force_started_resume: Force started — would start regardless of limits
reason.seed_target_reached: Seed target reached ({{mode}}) — would stop seeding
reason.seed_target_unknown: Seed target cannot be checked on this engine, so it keeps seeding
reason.seed_target_waiting_for_import: Target reached, but waiting for Media Intake to finish importing
reason.seed_target_waiting_for_library_copy: Target reached, but the library copy has not been verified
reason.seed_target_removal_not_supported: Target reached — removing a torrent is not done by the scheduler; remove it yourself when ready
reason.seed_target_reached_left_active: Target reached, and your policy says to keep seeding
reason.protected_from_removal: Target reached, but this torrent is protected from being stopped
reason.schedule_blocks_new_downloads: A schedule window is open that stops new downloads starting
reason.excluded_by_operator: You excluded this torrent from the scheduler

limitation.title: What this engine cannot do
limitation.no_pause_support: This engine cannot pause a torrent, so the scheduler cannot manage its queue at all.
limitation.no_queued_state: This engine does not report which torrents are queued, so waiting torrents are inferred rather than read.
limitation.no_seed_time_data: This engine does not report how long a torrent has been seeding, so seed-time targets cannot be enforced.
limitation.no_global_rate_limit: This engine's connection does not expose a global speed limit, so bandwidth policy cannot be applied globally.
limitation.no_per_torrent_rate_limit: This engine cannot set a speed limit on a single torrent.
limitation.force_start_approximated: Force start is approximated on this engine (high priority rather than a true force flag), so it may still yield to the engine's own queue.
limitation.native_queue_conflict: This engine has its own queue limits that may conflict with these policies.
limitation.no_availability_data: This engine does not report swarm availability.
limitation.bandwidth_reserve_unsupported: A download/seed bandwidth split was requested but cannot be honoured — this engine exposes one upload ceiling, not two. The overall limit is still applied.

priority.intake_waiting: Media Intake is waiting on it

scheduler.modeChangeFailed: Could not change the scheduling mode.

policies.title: Policies
policies.subtitle: Limits the scheduler enforces. Only concurrency limits are applied today — bandwidth and seeding arrive with the phases that enforce them.
policies.none: No policies yet. Without one, every limit is unlimited and the scheduler changes nothing.
policies.name: Name
policies.scopeIdHelp: The id of the engine, library, category, rule or torrent this applies to.
policies.limitsHelp: Leave a limit empty for unlimited. A more specific policy overrides a broader one field by field, so a library policy that sets only seeds still inherits the download limit above it.
policies.deleteConfirm: Delete this policy? Torrents governed by it fall back to the next policy up.

seeding.title: Seeding
seeding.help: What happens once a completed torrent has seeded enough. Only ratio targets can be enforced today — neither engine reports how long a torrent has been seeding, so time-based targets would never be checkable.
seeding.afterTargetHelp: Removing the torrent is not offered: taking a payload away has to pass Media Intake's safety checks, so the scheduler leaves that to you.
seeding.requireImportCompleted: Wait until Media Intake has imported it
seeding.requireLibraryCopyVerified: Wait until the library copy is verified
seeding.safetyHelp: Usually the reason to seed past completion is that the library copy is not safe yet.

bandwidth.title: Bandwidth
bandwidth.help: An engine-wide speed ceiling. Leave empty for unlimited.
bandwidth.reserveNote: A percentage split between downloading and seeding is not offered: both engines expose a single upload ceiling rather than two, so a reserve could not be honoured.

activation.title: Enable enforcement
activation.intro: The scheduler is about to start pausing and resuming torrents on this engine. Here is exactly what it would do right now.

blocker.engine_cannot_pause: This engine cannot pause or resume torrents, so the scheduler cannot manage its queue.

warning.queued_state_inferred: This engine does not report which torrents are queued, so waiting torrents are inferred rather than read.
warning.force_start_approximated: Force start is approximated on this engine, so a force-started torrent may still yield to the engine's own queue.
warning.parking_also_enabled: Junk-queue parking is also enabled and pauses torrents for its own reasons. The two coexist — the scheduler leaves parked torrents alone — but two systems will be pausing torrents on this engine.
warning.no_policies: You have no scheduling policies, so every limit is unlimited and enabling this would change nothing.

activation.deactivateIntro: The engine returns to its own queue behaviour.
activation.heldPaused: The scheduler is currently holding {{count}} torrent(s) paused.
activation.resumePausedHelp: Off by default: resuming everything would start downloads you did not choose to start, and some of those pauses may look like ones you made yourself.

overrides.title: Per-torrent overrides
overrides.help: Instructions about one torrent that override whatever your policies decided.

kind.protect_from_pause: Never pause to free a slot
kind.protect_from_removal: Never stop for meeting a seed target

kindHelp.protect_from_pause: It still counts toward your limits and can still be started by the scheduler — it just will not be paused to make room.
kindHelp.protect_from_removal: Seeding continues past its target rather than being stopped.
kindHelp.exclude: The scheduler will neither pause nor start it. Different from protecting: an excluded torrent is outside its authority in both directions.
kindHelp.force_start: It runs even when that exceeds your limits, so the rest of the queue has that much less room.

overrides.none: No overrides. Your policies apply to every torrent equally.
